bio.text: Martin Zamora, a Republican from Clovis, is the candidate for New Mexico's 3rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Rep. Teresa Leger Fernández.
He has represented New Mexico House District 63 since January 2019 and announced during the 2026 legislative session that he was leaving that office.
He was born on a farm near Clovis and is a farmer and rancher; according to his campaign website, he and his wife have owned agricultural businesses in Curry, Torrance and Socorro counties.

sources.title: Leger Fernández faces Rep. Zamora in bid for fourth term in Congressional District 3
